sources.price: OpenCode Go published rates (deepseek, glm, mimo, luna); Anthropic first-party rates for claude-haiku-5-5 (prompts up to 100K tokens).
sources.notes: Written by Claude Opus 5.5 from public model descriptions and dsh-bench measurements. measured = dsh-bench: 12 SWE-bench Verified pytest tasks, 600 s and 64 model calls per task, single agent and native subagents pooled over 2 runs (48 cases).

models.strengths: Cheapest strong coding executor; cache reads are 2% of input, so long append-only sessions are very cheap; reliable tool-call format.
models.weaknesses: About one tool call per step and frequent re-reads, so it runs out of a call budget on hard tasks; tends to stop once its own reproduction passes.

models.strengths: Same profile and price as v4.1-flash; a decorrelated second opinion within the family is weak.
models.weaknesses: Hits the call budget most often of the measured models.

models.strengths: Batches tool calls: about 37% fewer calls per task than deepseek flash at similar resolution, rarely hits the call budget; solves some tasks deepseek flash misses, so it is a decorrelated reviewer for deepseek executors.
models.weaknesses: Cache reads cost 10x deepseek flash; slower per call; misses some tasks deepseek flash solves.

models.strengths: Lowest output price; a third model family, so its review errors are least correlated with deepseek and glm executors.
models.weaknesses: Not yet measured on dsh-bench; paid route only.

models.strengths: Deeper reasoning than flash at about 4x the price; good for one-off diagnosis and plans from a compact brief.
models.weaknesses: Same family as deepseek flash, so it shares some blind spots; too expensive as the step-by-step executor under a call budget.

models.strengths: Strong agentic coder and reviewer from a different family than deepseek.
models.weaknesses: Most expensive model here; use for short advisor consultations only.

models.strengths: Cheapest pro-tier reasoning per output token; third family.
models.weaknesses: Not yet measured on dsh-bench; paid route only.

models.strengths: Careful instruction following and concise, well-calibrated reviews at flash-tier price; a family independent of all executors here.
models.weaknesses: Price rises to 0.5 / 2.5 above 100K-token prompts, so give it compact briefs; paid route only; not yet measured on dsh-bench.

models.strengths: Low price with strong reasoning for its tier.
models.weaknesses: Unavailable from this deployment: the provider rejects the region (unsupported_country_region_territory).
